evidence.reason: The finding's original concern is the bare HEAD equality check at the old lines 2273-2274. Current code at lines 2337-2347 still checks HEAD, but then loads the locally retained deploy transaction for that deployed SHA and refuses unless the supplied journal matches it (`_matches_retained`). This binds rollback to the retained transaction rather than only HEAD. Commit 2ddb890fd5d3b238ce758496b9efe70ea302e54f is titled "bind rollback to the locally retained deploy transaction" and introduces exactly this fix; later commits refine retained-record selection and approval-tag matching.
